products.name: Black Horse Accommodation
products.description: With a stay at this aparthotel in Stellenbosch (Stellenbosch Central), you'll be steps from Dorp Street and 4 minutes by foot from Toy & Miniature Museum. The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Free self parking is available onsite.

products.name: Albergaria Senhora do Espinheiro
products.description: Located in Seia, Albergaria Senhora do Espinheiro is in the mountains, within a 15-minute drive of Bread Museum and Toy Museum. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.
